extDescription.message: Ask AI about the page you're reading: summaries, explanations and translations without leaving Safari.

emptyTitle.message: What would you like to know?

emptyPage.message: I can see this page. Ask a question or pick an action.

emptySelection.message: Ask about the selected text or pick an action.

emptyNone.message: This page can't be read, but you can ask me anything.

promptSummarize.message: Summarize this page in 5–7 bullet points, then give the main conclusion in one sentence.

promptKeyPoints.message: What are the key takeaways from this page? List the important facts, numbers and dates.

promptExplain.message: Explain this page in simple words, as if to a smart 12-year-old.

promptTranslate.message: Translate the main content of this page into {0}. Keep the structure and headings.

promptSelExplain.message: Explain the selected text in simple words.

promptSelImprove.message: Rewrite the selected text to be clearer and more concise. Give one improved version.

promptReply.message: Draft a short, polite reply to this message or post.

promptGoogle.message: Search Google for the latest information on the topic of this page and give me an overview.

promptSelGoogle.message: Search Google for the selected text: what is it, with the key facts.

chatsEmpty.message: No chats yet. Ask something to start one.

chatNameHint.message: Leave it empty to name the chat after its first question.

errNetwork.message: No connection. Check your internet and try again.

errBusy.message: ContextFlow is very busy right now. Please try again in a minute.

errUpstream.message: The AI service didn't respond. Please try again.

errBadKey.message: Your API key was rejected. Check it in Settings.

errGeneric.message: Something went wrong. Please try again.

errSearchLimit.message: You've reached the limit of Google answers for now. Regular answers still work.

errSearchUnavailable.message: Google answers aren't available right now. Regular answers still work.

usagePro.message: Pro · {0} of {1} answers left this week

consentBody.message: To answer, ContextFlow sends your question and the text of this page (or your selection) via our server to OpenAI, or to Google for Google answers. Page content and chats are not stored on our servers; your chats stay on your devices and, if you sync them, in your iCloud.

setFabHint.message: The ✦ button opens ContextFlow on any site. Hide it on a single site with the link below, or turn it off here.

setAboutHint.message: Optional. Helps tailor answers, e.g. “I'm a product designer, keep it short”.

setOwnKeyHint.message: Included in Pro and Own key plans. Paste an OpenAI or Anthropic (Claude) key; requests go straight from your device to that provider.

setOwnKeyLocked.message: Available with Pro or Own key plan

setOwnKeyModelHint.message: Fast: newest Claude Haiku or GPT mini. Smart: newest Claude Sonnet or GPT.

setSyncChatsHint.message: Continue a chat on your iPhone, iPad and Mac. The chat is end-to-end encrypted in your iCloud and never stored on our servers.

googleModeHint.message: Answer with Google Search: fresh facts with sources

tourAskBody.message: ContextFlow reads the page you're on. Pick an action like Summarize, or type your own question.

tourSelectBody.message: Select text on the page first, and the answer is about just that. This label shows what ContextFlow reads.

tourGoogleBody.message: Turn this on to answer with Google Search: current information with sources.

tourChatsBody.message: A chat carries on from page to page. Start a new one with +, and open, rename or delete earlier ones in the chat list. Tap a page's name in the chat to go back to it.

tourChatsBodySync.message: A chat carries on from page to page, and on your iPhone, iPad and Mac through iCloud. Start a new one with +, and open, rename or delete earlier ones in the chat list. Tap a page's name in the chat to go back to it.

tourSettingsBody.message: Theme and text size, the ✦ button, a few words about you for better answers, your own API key and your plan. These tips are here too.

tourNoteBodyTouch.message: Swipe this button up or down to write a note instead of asking. It stays in the chat with its page and uses no answers.

tourNoteBodyMouse.message: Scroll on this button (or hold it) to write a note instead of asking. It stays in the chat with its page and uses no answers.

tourWholeBody.message: Turn on Whole chat when a question needs everything: all messages, your notes and the other pages of this chat. Off, answers use the last messages and this page.

welcomeBody.message: Open any website and tap the ✦ button or the ContextFlow icon in the toolbar. Select text to ask about just that part.

welcomeRestricted.message: Safari doesn't let extensions read this page. Open a regular website to use ContextFlow.

welcomePermission.message: If nothing happens, allow ContextFlow on all websites: Safari → Extensions → ContextFlow → All Websites → Allow.

placeholderNote.message: Write a note — it stays in this chat

noteHintTouch.message: Swipe the button up or down to write a note

noteHintMouse.message: Scroll on the button to write a note

wholeChatHint.message: Answers take the whole chat into account: every message, your notes and the pages of this chat. Off: the last messages and the open page.

limitFreePro.message: Pro gives you up to {0} answers a week.

limitNotes.message: Notes stay free and unlimited: write down what matters now, ask AI about it later.

offerLimit.message: Or get Pro with {0}% off your first month: up to {1} answers a week on a smarter model. Cancel any time.

offerCardBody.message: You've hit the free daily limit before. Pro gives you up to {1} answers a week on a smarter model, and your first month is {0}% off. Then the regular price; cancel any time in your App Store settings.

emptyVideo.message: I can see this video and will read its transcript. Ask a question or pick an action.

emptyPdf.message: I can see this PDF. Ask a question or pick an action.

videoNoTranscript.message: This video has no captions: the answer uses its title and description.

videoFailed.message: Couldn’t get this video’s transcript: the answer uses its title and description.

pdfNoText.message: “{0}” has no text to read (scanned pages): the answer is without it.

pdfFailed.message: Couldn’t read the PDF “{0}”: the answer is without it.
